svg.title: Microscope
svg.desc: Compound light microscope with binocular head, rotating objectives, stage, condenser, focus knobs, illuminator, and base. Biological basis: Compound microscopes form magnified images using objective and eyepiece systems while the stage, condenser, and focus drive position the specimen and illumination.
